title: I'm building an engine designed for use by AI, and released my first game with it.
author: shaunwild
selftext:
This is Mega Merge, a suika rogue-lite. It plays like a normal fruit-merging game, but you get to select modifiers that allow for some crazy runs. I'm really enjoying developing it, and the feedback I've been receiving is great.

  
The engine is designed to be AI-oriented by exposing game state via an MCP, screenshots are a last resort, and the entire world state can be retrieved in JSON format. This is super cool, because agents can play with the game and test things out manually. 

I have a team of 5 parallel agents that run in the cloud, working on game features in parallel, and a team lead that orchestrates the agents and merges the changes into master. They implement changes, take screenshots, and post updates to a dashboard where I can give feedback or suggest new ideas entirely.

The agents can even soak test, they created a bot that plays the game, and they read the world state and can spot bugs etc that even humans wouldn't notice. 

  
The game is on Steam, if you would like to check it out, I am currently working on a demo.

  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750230/Mega\_Merge/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750230/Mega_Merge/)

  
Any questions on my setup, drop a reply :)
